newsitem.title: USA: Circuit city Sept same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Circuit city Sept same-store sales fall.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc. said Friday its September 1996 sales were $561.2 million compared with September 1995 sales of $558.7 million. The results include a 13 percent decline in comparable store sales.

"September's sales performance reflects a further slowdown in the home PC business and continued strength in big-screen televisions, digital satellite systems and major appliances," said Richard Sharp, Circuit City's chairman and chief executive officer. "The results also reflect our strong prior year comparisons and one less Saturday this year compared with last year."

During the month, Circuit City opened one new Superstore in Newport News, Va. The company expects to open 35 additional Circuit City Superstores by the holiday selling season and to begin the national roll out of the CarMax concept with the opening of its Orlando location in early November.
